title: Deciding to go to Chicago in 1925
summary: He gave bands to former players who never did anything with them.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: That's hot. They're barbecue. It's very good. Thank you. Wonderful. Listen. So when did you go to Chicago? 1925. Were you here all the way until 25? Los Angeles. In Los Angeles or here huh? Between here and Los Angeles.
What made you go to Chicago? I don't want to see the country. I had to work. I was waiting for a man at this band.

He gave away two of his bands? I gave Papa Mudman a band. One of them? And gave Titty Girl and another? Another one. They were always trying to be leaders. So I gave them a band. They never did do nothing. He came home and found them starving when he came back to the west coast. So.
